acceptance_predicates.description: CI derives public command and eligible step coverage mechanically and fails for omitted quiet support, output-router bypasses, missing instrumentation, or renderer bypasses.

Controlled defects prove rejection of direct status writes, invalid tokens, fake totals/ETAs, missing final state, quiet leaks, JSON stream leaks, ANSI leaks, and incomplete progress lifecycle behavior.
Executable tests prove --json emits no human status, update, progress, ANSI, or carriage-return bytes on either stdout or stderr for every command family and relevant failure path.
PTY, resize, narrow-width, redirected, broken-pipe, interruption, nesting, warning, failure, and cancellation cases retain safe consistent behavior.
A new command or eligible operation cannot merge until it declares quiet behavior, structured step instrumentation, truthful progress inputs, and mode tests.

definition_of_done: Required CI gates and controlled-defect suites pass at the exact reviewed head.
Documentation gives contributors a mechanically enforced extension path.
Independent review, signed merge, and exact-main hosted workflows pass.
